name: Zoo Miami Wildlife Conservation Fund
summary: Yearly small grants of up to US$5,000 for wildlife and ecosystem conservation projects worldwide, open to non-profits, individuals and governments.

eligibility.rule: Submit all application materials in English
Submit no more than one application per organisation or individual each year

documents: W-9 form for grants to U.S. domestic locations
W-8eci form for international fund transfers

geography.quote: promote efforts toward the conservation of wildlife and natural ecosystems throughout the world
